statement_en: If $\{E_i\}_{i\geq 1}$ are pairwise disjoint and each is $\mu^{*}$-measurable, then not only is their union measurable, but also countable additivity holds: $$\mu^{*}\left(\bigcup_{i\geq 1}E_i\right)=\sum_{i\geq 1}\mu^{*}(E_i).$$
callout_body: 如果$\{E_i\}_{i\geq 1}$两两不相交，并且都是$\mu^{*}-$可测的集合，那么不仅它们的并是可测的，此外还成立可数可加性:$$\mu^{*}\left(\bigcup_{i\geq 1}E_i\right)=\sum_{i\geq 1}\mu^{*}(E_i)$$
